sources.title: Azure for Students
sources.summary: Student cloud entitlement with a 12-month credit allocation and annual student-status renewal path.
eligibility_text: Verify current full-time student eligibility and whether the applicant already has or previously used the entitlement.

sources.title: Heroku for GitHub Students
sources.summary: GitHub Student Developer Pack benefit for Heroku application and data-service usage.
eligibility_text: Requires active GitHub Student Developer Pack eligibility. Monthly credits do not roll over.

sources.title: Appwrite Education
sources.summary: Student plan for educational projects with two projects and Pro-equivalent usage limits.
eligibility_text: Requires GitHub Student Developer Pack. Education entitlement is noncommercial; paid pilots must use a commercial plan or other infrastructure.

sources.title: MongoDB Student Pack
sources.summary: Student Atlas credit and certification benefit; redeem only when a MongoDB workload exists because the code has an activation clock.
eligibility_text: Requires GitHub Student Developer Pack. Verify current redemption clock and payment-method requirements before activation.

sources.title: YZU campus-licensed software
sources.summary: University-licensed research and productivity software including Microsoft, SAS and MATLAB resources.
eligibility_text: Use only within current university licensing scope and while affiliation permits.

sources.title: YZU Library electronic resources
sources.summary: University database catalogue for academic research and teaching; catalogue composition is dynamic.
eligibility_text: Academic research/teaching use only; no commercial use or systematic bulk downloading. Do not hardcode a database count.

sources.title: OpenAI Researcher Access Program
sources.summary: Research API-credit program for eligible affiliated researchers studying responsible AI deployment, risks or societal impacts.
eligibility_text: Verify current research affiliation and supported API country. Reviews occur quarterly; no exact September cutoff should be invented.

sources.title: Anthropic Model Hardware Standard research preview
sources.summary: Research-preview access for model-to-hardware interfaces across science, robotics, electronics and manufacturing.
eligibility_text: No hard deadline is published. Verify whether individual/student affiliation is sufficient for the current initial cohort.

sources.title: Anthropic AI for Science
sources.summary: Expanded Claude-credit support for scientific research across disciplines.
eligibility_text: Any researcher may apply under the current expansion. University applicants must satisfy applicable institutional-consent requirements. No first-Monday/monthly deadline is encoded without an official source.

sources.title: Claude Team plan for scientists
sources.summary: PI-led lab access to Claude Team seats for academic/nonprofit scientific research.
eligibility_text: PI or equivalent must complete verification and add researchers; this is a dependency route, not a direct individual entitlement.

sources.title: Google Cloud Academic Research Credits
sources.summary: Research-only cloud credits for eligible faculty/postdocs and PhD students in supported countries.
eligibility_text: Master's students are ineligible directly. Taiwan is supported. Faculty/postdoc route is up to US$5,000; PhD route up to US$1,000. PI dependency must clear before application preparation.

sources.title: Oracle for Research Project Award
sources.summary: Institution-oriented research-cloud award with OCI resources sized to documented research requirements.
eligibility_text: PI/institutional application and legal/technical contacts are required. Funding amount is variable and must come from a defensible OCI cost model.

sources.title: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
sources.summary: Research-cloud credits with a student request ceiling but an unresolved Greater-China processing restriction for Taiwan.
eligibility_text: Graduate students may request up to US$5,000, but AWS currently says applications from the greater China region cannot be processed. Obtain written clarification for Taiwan before application work.
